data.title: Frame spikes every few seconds
data.report: Playback stutters on the 8-view setup. Average frame time looks fine.

data.summary: p50 11.8 ms, p99 41.3 ms; spikes about every 3 s

data.text: Frame time spikes above 40 ms roughly every 3 seconds; the median is normal.

data.summary: Main thread waits on the asset-loader lock for 29 ms during each spike

data.text: Each spike lines up with the main thread waiting on the asset-loader lock.

data.summary: File reads happen while the asset loader holds its lock; the render thread blocks behind them.
data.fix: Read the file before taking the lock; hold the lock only to publish the loaded asset.
checks: p99 frame time back under 14 ms on setup D
